nodes.label: Skill: eventar-card-git-workflow
nodes.rationale: Claim card, commit by pathspec, push only approved SHA. Claim: check list_sessions for card ID before building; never kill duplicate sessions; push approval belongs to the session where given. Commit: GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1, git reset/add by paths only (never bare reset), git diff --cached must list exactly the group, read git diff of each file for foreign hunks, peer files stay unstaged, split files via temp GIT_INDEX_FILE, quote bracket paths, commit messages name only gates actually run, reissue once if RTK hook rewrites command. Push: only on explicit go naming the SHA in this session; git push origin <sha>:refs/heads/main as its own command; never bare git push or force; rejected push means peer pushed first, fetch and ask for a fresh go; origin public so classifier may deny, hand Ivan the one-line command.
